def guard(event,args):

    if event=="open" and isinstance(args[0],str) and pathlib.Path(args[0]).name.startswith(".env"):

    if event=="import" and str(args[0]).split(".")[0] in {"psycopg2","psycopg","docker","main"}:
        raise RuntimeError("Forbidden app/database/container import")
